key_highlights: ASX closed the week higher despite late dips, shadowed by escalating domestic headwinds.
Department store icon David Jones faces collapse, triggering retail and mall REIT contagion.
Qantas flags a $1B fuel cost surge, cutting flight schedules and pushing airfares higher.
Macro stagnation and reduced borrowing capacity accelerate Australian housing price declines.
Resource juniors and gold equities outperform amid active exploration capital raisings.

sectors.trend: Severe solvency crisis at David Jones with mounting unpaid supplier claims and pre-Christmas disruption.
sectors.implications: Downside earnings risk for retail suppliers and discretionary consumer brands heading into peak season.

sectors.trend: Loss of major department store anchors poses foot-traffic and lease valuation risks for shopping centres.
sectors.implications: Asset revaluation headwinds and occupancy re-leasing drag for retail landlords like SCG.AX and VCX.AX.

sectors.trend: Shrinking mortgage borrowing capacity threatens home prices, mirroring New Zealand's property downturn.
sectors.implications: Slowing loan book growth and higher credit provision risks across major lenders CBA.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX, and NAB.AX.

sectors.trend: Escalating jet fuel costs force major domestic carriers to trim capacity and hike ticket prices.
sectors.implications: Margin compression for Qantas (QAN.AX) and broader travel demand destruction amid consumer belt-tightening.

sectors.trend: Strong capital raising momentum across gold explorers and junior critical mineral plays.
sectors.implications: Supportive liquidity environment for gold and battery metal equities including CHN.AX, BPM.AX, and AGC.AX.

sectors.trend: AI infrastructure expansion faces community opposition and planning delays despite structural tailwinds.
sectors.implications: Approval bottlenecks may increase development cycle times for data centre players like NEXTDC (NXT.AX).

key_themes: Insolvency risks in legacy retail spilling into commercial real estate and trade creditors.
Monetary tightening transmission driving residential property correction and sub-trend GDP growth.
Input cost inflation in aviation and infrastructure dampening corporate margins.
Equity market dispersion favouring gold and exploration plays over rate-sensitive domestic cyclicals.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Department Store Liquidation & Supplier Credit Contagion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid exposed discretionary suppliers; scrutinise trade credit insurance and accounts receivable exposures.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Accelerating Housing Price Correction & Mortgage Contraction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight domestic retail banks; tilt financial exposure toward institutional and diversified asset managers.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Aviation Fuel Cost Inflation & Margin Erosion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight transport and travel stocks; maintain exposure to energy producers benefiting from firm oil prices.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Data Centre Planning Hurdles & Community Pushback
risk_assessment.mitigation: Target well-capitalised digital infrastructure operators holding fully approved development sites.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate top-tier gold miners and funded exploration juniors
opportunities.rationale: Strong capital-market appetite and elevated bullion prices provide defensive positioning and growth.

opportunities.recommendation: Selectively buy data centre leaders on planning pullback
opportunities.rationale: Secular AI compute demand outweighs near-term site-level community objections.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim retail mall REITs and vulnerable consumer retail vendors
defensive_moves.rationale: David Jones collapse risks rental arrears, anchor tenant vacancies, and discounted inventory dumping.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce weighting in major domestic banks and airline operators
defensive_moves.rationale: High borrowing costs stifle loan volumes while a $1B fuel surge squeezes transport operating earnings.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound ASX 200 trading as retail weakness and energy inflation cap broader market upside.
market_outlook.long_term: Muted Australian GDP growth and household balance sheet pressure will reward low-leverage resource and quality defensive stocks.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate guidance and transmission to mortgage debt serviceability
David Jones creditor administration developments and retail vacancy fill rates
Qantas interim capacity adjustments and international fuel crack spread trends
Pre-Christmas retail trading figures and consumer spending momentum
watch_list: Australian housing auction clearance rates and credit growth statistics
ASX resource junior capital raisings and gold bullion price trajectory
Crude oil price trends and QAN.AX passenger yield resilience
Australian consumer sentiment and retail trade monthly releases
